A '''species''' of '''[[Bird/Legends|bird]]''' with a '''beak shaped like a [[Horn/Legends|horn]]''' inhabited the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. One with [[Color/Legends|green]] feathers was flying near [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], and it later cowered in terror when the village was attacked by [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]].<ref name="1-02"/> Another sat on a tree perch and observed two [[Munyip/Legends|munyips]] kissing in a neighboring tree.<ref name="1-11">{{Ewoks|The Three Lessons}}</ref> A blue-feathered bird was seen flying away in terror when [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] played a prank by dressing up as a monster to scare his friends.<ref name="2-05" />
